automatic_continuity.enabled_by: trusted enabled native project hooks running one unargumented context-continuity.sh on session start, prompt and end of turn; never bypass client trust or permissions
automatic_continuity.storage: .context-handoff/ under the project root, or under the launcher's state directory in attached mode
automatic_continuity.scope: local ignored same-repository, same-Git-branch convenience state; excluded from Project Brain, Memory Bank, SQLite, automatic retrieval, and Git
automatic_continuity.visible_input: documented visible prompt or assistant text, or an explicit visible .txt/.md/.markdown export; known JSONL shapes are projected to visible user/assistant text only
automatic_continuity.excluded_input: private account/session stores, hidden reasoning, system/tool envelopes, arbitrary JSONL, and invented transcript text
automatic_continuity.dispatch: --event hook reads the payload's hook_event_name: SessionStart/sessionStart delivers; UserPromptSubmit, Stop, beforeSubmitPrompt and afterAgentResponse capture; any other event does nothing
automatic_continuity.restore: only a merge explicitly prepared with context-load merge: a new task claims the merge waiting for its client, a merged task receives the same frozen sources plus its own current progress on resume or compact; nothing else is restored, because the Task Capsule carries a branch's work into the next session; total preview at most 6000 UTF-8 bytes including headers
automatic_continuity.selection: context-load merge lists captured host:session IDs and prepares 2-8 selected sources for the next new task in the destination host; one pending merge per branch/host, no overwrite
automatic_continuity.identity: every hook payload's session_id for codex/claude, conversation_id for cursor; a missing or invalid identity stores and delivers nothing
automatic_continuity.creation: native task creation only through a supported client tool when the current user asks; otherwise await a newly opened task
commands: python3 memory-bank/scripts/context_continuity.py --host CLIENT --event merge --source-session HOST:ID_A --source-session HOST:ID_B
automatic_continuity.limits: 32 MiB serialized per frozen archive; 128 archives and 256 MiB total per checkout; refuse new archives at quota without evicting existing task history
automatic_continuity.disabled_restore_by: CONTEXT_CONTINUITY_RESTORE_DISABLED=1, true, or yes; capture remains enabled
automatic_continuity.snapshots: one visible-text snapshot per chat, the 8 most recent per branch kept
automatic_continuity.skipped_when: CONTEXT_MEMORY_RECOVERY=1 (a draft-only recovery is not part of the conversation)
